name: Event Horizon
description: Black holes: a round hole ringed by bright lensed light, with a glowing accretion disk lying across it, one side brighter than the other.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: @r(-26deg, 26deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 34%, #000 34% 39%, #00000073 45%, transparent 76%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -14%; background: var(--color1); transform: rotate(@var(--t)); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 58% 6.5% at 42% 50%, #000 0 50%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
